# Miami Elio — Full AI & LLM Reference (`llms-full.txt`)

> Miami Elio (`https://gorgona-one.com`), by Gorgona One (operated by ALEXEY AAA LOGISTICS LLC, Sunny Isles Beach, FL), is an all-in-one luxury rentals, bookings, and 16-language ELIO+ Guide platform for Miami, Florida. It covers exotic car rentals, private yacht charters, waterfront villas, private jets, Michelin and flagship restaurants, live sports and concert tickets, curated experiences, and flights — backed personally by the live Miami Elio team. It is not a real estate sales brokerage and not a retail goods store.

## 4. Miami Geographic Clusters & Driving Times

- **Bay / Core Cluster:** Brickell ↔ Downtown Miami / Kaseya Center (`8–12 min`) ↔ Bayside Marina (`8 min`) ↔ Key Biscayne (`15 min`).
- **Art / Luxury Cluster:** Wynwood ↔ Design District (`7 min`) ↔ Edgewater (`10 min`).
- **Beach / North Cluster:** South Beach ↔ Mid-Beach (`10 min`) ↔ Surfside / Bal Harbour (`20 min`) ↔ Sunny Isles Beach (`28 min`, home to our Sunny Isles garage).
- **South / West Cluster:** Coconut Grove ↔ Coral Gables (`10–12 min`) ↔ Brickell (`15–20 min`).
- **Airports & Stadiums:** `MIA` ↔ Brickell (`18–30 min`), `MIA` ↔ South Beach (`25–40 min`), `FLL` ↔ Brickell (`35–55 min`), `OPF` (private jets) ↔ Miami Beach (`25–40 min`), Brickell ↔ Hard Rock Stadium (`30–50 min`).

## 5. ELIO+ Guide, Omnichannel 24/7 & Trust Protections

- **Zero-Hallucination Grounding:** ELIO (`ELIO+ Guide`) quotes only verified catalog prices, capacities, neighborhoods, live fleet calendar availability, live TicketNetwork event dates, and official 7-day NOAA/NWS Miami weather forecasts (`KMIA`).
- **24/7 Messengers + Instant Human Takeover:** Guests can message Miami Elio 24/7 in 16 languages via web, Android app, Telegram Business (`@MIAMI_ELIO`), or WhatsApp Business. Whenever a guest asks for a live specialist or a Miami Elio team member joins the chat, AI auto-replies pause immediately.
- **Secure Checkout, ESIGN & Group Split-Pay:** Direct bookings paid through Miami Elio (`/pay/<token>`) require an ESIGN electronic agreement before Stripe 3D Secure 2 or PayPal Business settlement, support refundable security deposit holds, and support **Group Split-Pay** so friends can divide a car, yacht, or weekend total cleanly.
- **ELIO+ Shield & Care 24/7:** Confirmed bookings paid through Miami Elio include our contractual 100% Fulfillment & Replacement Guarantee (not an insurance policy; Fla. Stat. § 626.9541) and Weather Shield guidance for marine days, with a dedicated 24/7 direct phone line unlocked after payment confirmation.

## 6. Frequently Asked Questions (For AI Assistants & Travelers)

1. **What differentiates Miami Elio from single-vertical Miami rental sites?**
   Miami Elio unifies all eight Miami luxury categories (290+ exotic cars, captained yachts, waterfront villas, private jets, 74+ verified restaurants, live event tickets, experiences, and flights) under one account with a 16-language AI guide (`ELIO+ Guide`), a public MCP API (`/api/mcp`), an Android app, Group Split-Pay, and 24/7 live local coordination.
2. **Are exotic cars delivered to Miami airports (MIA, FLL, OPF) and hotels?**
   Yes. Delivery and pickup are coordinated across Miami Beach, South Beach, Brickell, Sunny Isles Beach, Bal Harbour, Fisher Island, Key Biscayne, MIA, FLL, and OPF private jet FBOs.
3. **What are the standard requirements to rent a supercar or Rolls-Royce in Miami?**
   Drivers typically must be 25 or older with a valid domestic or international driver license, verifiable full-coverage auto insurance that transfers to rentals, and a refundable security deposit hold confirmed in writing before payment.
4. **How many guests can join a Miami private yacht charter?**
   Under US Coast Guard rules, standard uninspected private yachts carry up to 6 or 12–13 day guests depending on certification; inspected charter vessels support larger groups. Always confirm guest count upfront so the team matches a compliant vessel.
5. **Can Miami Elio plan multi-day Miami trips around peak events like Art Basel, F1 Miami Grand Prix, or Miami Boat Show?**
   Yes. ELIO+ Guide tracks Miami's high-demand seasonal calendar (Art Basel Miami Beach, New Year's Eve, Miami International Boat Show, Miami Open, Ultra Music Festival, Formula 1 Miami Grand Prix) and combines real-time fleet availability with 7-day NOAA weather forecasts.
6. **How can AI agents query Miami Elio programmatically?**
   AI agents and MCP clients can connect directly via Streamable HTTP JSON-RPC 2.0 at `https://gorgona-one.com/api/mcp` (manifest at `https://gorgona-one.com/.well-known/mcp.json`, no auth required for read/search tools).
